summary: AITX filed a routine 8-K furnishing a product press release, not a special situation. On September 10, 2026, the registrant announced commercial availability of SARA Assess, an agentic AI risk-assessment software integration developed with Circadian Risk, marking SARA's first third-party physical risk intelligence integration outside RAD's hardware ecosystem. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed. Filed under Items 8.01 and 9.01 with Exhibit 99.1, signed by CEO Steven Reinharz. What to watch: ordinary product commercialization news with no deal or arbitrage angle.
